answer: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id=hp.power_id WHERE hp.hero_id=s.id AND sp.power_name='Super Strength')
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id=s.alignment_id WHERE a.alignment IS NULL OR a.alignment NOT IN ('Good','Bad')

WITH t AS (SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) c FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id=s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id=hp.power_id WHERE p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('','-') GROUP BY sp.id, sp.power_name) SELECT power_name, c FROM t WHERE c=(SELECT MAX(c) FROM t)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name='DC Comics' AND s.weight_kg>0 AND s.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT s2.eye_colour_id FROM superhero s2 JOIN publisher p2 ON p2.id=s2.publisher_id WHERE p2.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND s2.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON r.id=s.race_id WHERE s.weight_kg>0 AND r.race NOT IN ('','-') AND r.id NOT IN (SELECT s2.race_id FROM superhero s2 JOIN gender g ON g.id=s2.gender_id WHERE g.gender='Female' AND s2.race_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT g.gender, ROUND(1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp JOIN superhero s2 ON s2.id=hp.hero_id WHERE s2.gender_id=g.id AND s2.full_name LIKE '% %')/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s3 WHERE s3.gender_id=g.id AND s3.full_name LIKE '% %'),2) FROM gender g WHERE g.gender IN ('Male','Female')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.height_cm>0 THEN s.height_cm END),1), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg>0 THEN s.weight_kg END),1) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name='George Lucas'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON g.id=s.gender_id JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id=s.id WHERE g.gender='Male' AND s.weight_kg>0 AND s.weight_kg<70

SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment='Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id=s.alignment_id WHERE p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id=s.id)
